analysis_policy.scrna_reason: Only two paired AIS donors are present; inferential p-values, stable latent-factor estimation, and majority-donor communication filters are not defensible.
analysis_policy.cross_cell_axis: exploratory and must be validated in independent bulk data

series_overall_design: Bilateral paraspinal muscles of idiopathic scoliosis and congenital scoliosis patients were collected for transcriptome sequencing. Differentially expressed genes in paraspinal muscles of IS and CS between the convexity and the concavity were screened out.

Please note that 'A' samples indicate paraspinal muscles on the concavity from idiopathic or congenital scoliosis patients, whereas 'T' samples are muscles on the convexity in idiopathic or congenital scoliosis.
